proposed_action.intent: naive quadrupole correction for diffuse beam

reasons: machine state is outside the training envelope

elog_hits.title: Diffuse beam spot after quad_2 drift
elog_hits.text: Beam spot became diffuse after quad_2 drift during warm injector shift. Increasing quad_2 worsened halo. Operators restored quad_2 baseline and checked RF phase readback. Beam recovered after RF correction
elog_hits.recommended_action: Do not increase quad_2 until RF phase readback is verified. Take a calibration screen if uncertainty remains high

elog_hits.title: High beam loss after aggressive quadrupole tuning
elog_hits.text: A large simultaneous quad_1 and quad_2 move improved predicted size but caused measured beam loss. Operators reverted to smaller steps
elog_hits.recommended_action: Clip quadrupole moves and require approval for aggressive focusing

elog_hits.title: Night shift recovery from diffuse beam
elog_hits.text: Night shift recovered diffuse beam by checking RF phase before touching quad_2. Increasing quad_2 first made the halo worse
elog_hits.recommended_action: Check RF phase and take a screen before increasing quad_2
